document.about: DOE Weatherization Assistance Program fact sheet, 2 pages. Page 1 sets a shaded panel at the foot of the right column, a row of four round icons with a label of one or two lines under each; the last icon holds a `$`. The left column's text runs on level with the panel.

checks.issue: The labels' lines were read row by row across the icons: `LOWER OUT-OF-POCKET`, `LOWER LOAN INTEREST`, `HEALTH COSTS`, `PAYMENTS`.
As above, for the icon holding a `$`: a mark set on an icon is its lettering, not a box of text.
The `$` reads apart, before the row, as on the reading before the fix.
